reconstructed_captions.15: The man puts on a welding helmet and gloves to prepare for welding.
reconstructed_captions.16: He strikes an arc with a welding torch, creating a bright flash of light.
reconstructed_captions.17: A close-up view shows the welding torch laying a bead of molten metal into the crack.
reconstructed_captions.18: Sparks fly as the welder meticulously works along the length of the crack.
reconstructed_captions.19: The camera focuses on the growing bead of the weld, glowing red-hot.
reconstructed_captions.20: The welder completes a pass and pulls the torch away, revealing the fresh weld.
reconstructed_captions.21: The welder uses a chipping hammer to remove slag from the cooling weld.
reconstructed_captions.22: A close-up shows the dark slag flaking off to reveal the new metal underneath.
reconstructed_captions.23: The man uses a wire brush to clean the completed weld.
reconstructed_captions.24: The repaired area is shown, with the crack now filled by a solid weld.
reconstructed_captions.25: The man inspects the finished weld, checking for any imperfections.
reconstructed_captions.26: He prepares to move on to the next step of the repair, which is heating another part.
